description: Ministry of Labour - Hazardous Occupations Regulations of 2021
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Labour under the Employment of Women, Young Persons and Children Act, establishing legal prohibitions on hazardous occupations for young workers. It constitutes subsidiary legislation that creates new regulatory requirements and compliance obligations, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "new laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements."
